steps.title: Notes lead; Up next is the rationale
steps.rationale: The surface writers must match; the next step fills the words
steps.notes: Notes sit first under the title, unlabeled, and only the first 480 characters show. The rationale is read again as Up next before that step's code is on screen, so it has to make sense without identifiers and without pointing at the highlight.

steps.title: Translate in three moves
steps.rationale: The writing contract the prompts and examples will follow
steps.notes: Names coined while coding are unknown until they appear on screen. First say what changes for a person, then the part on screen and its job, then the identifier only if they will search for it.
